1479-3703-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1494-3365-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1978-4002-7714.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-7714.description:
Cast Sceptre of Eternal Glory by paying its mana cost.
When Sceptre of Eternal Glory enters, Ultron triggers
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Sceptre of Eternal Glory that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Sceptre of Eternal Glory into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
During your next turn, activate the Sceptre of Eternal Glory token by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Sceptre of Eternal Glory token.
Repeat from step 6.

670-1619-6151-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6151-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Underdark Explorer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}

11-2365-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2365-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Expropriate.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Expropriate spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Expropriate spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Expropriate and returning the original Expropriate to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Expropriate from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

967-3809-5686-6441-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

628-5670-6578--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-5670-6578--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat
628-5670-6578--5.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.
